name: Mahou Shoujo: Magical Shota
storyline:
Live out a charming love story between Shota, an ordinary high school student, and Asuka, a mysterious magical girl.
One day, when Shota was walking home from school, a monster attacked him. It was Asuka who came to save him from the monster.

Journey with them as their friendship blossoms into first love.

Journey through a story of trust, friendship, and romance set in a world where magic exists just beneath the surface. With beautiful art, an upbeat soundtrack, and a sweet story, Mahou Shoujo: Magical Shota will capture your heart.
summary:
Shota is a typical high school student living a normal life. One day, while he was walking home, he encountered a monster! Luckily, when the monster was about to attack Shota, he was unexpectedly saved by a mysterious magical girl! He was in awe as he got to know this girl, Asuka. Although she seemed strange at first, he soon grew to trust her and appreciate her presence. Over time, Shota's bond with her grew stronger and he began to develop feelings for her. From then on, he begins spending time with her and getting to know her.

Will Shota be able to win Asuka's love and live happily ever after? Find out in this cute story of love and magic!
